title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Grok 4.7 Launch & Gemini 3.8 Flash Release: Elon Musk announced Grok 4.7 is launching in 10 days, while Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash, delivering near-Opus 5 performance at lower cost and latency on TerminalBench 2.1.

Uber Cuts 10% of Staff for $10B Robotaxi Shift: Uber ($UBER) announced a 3,300-person layoff (20% of management) to cut costs and redirect over $10 billion into autonomous robotaxi fleet partnerships.

Leopold Aschenbrenner Portfolio & 13F Filing: Updated disclosures revealed Leopold Aschenbrenner's fund positions are concentrated heavily in memory ($SNDK 28.1%, $MU 27.6%) and power ($BE 9.4%) while completely closing semiconductor put hedges.
Air China B747 JFK Fuel Spill Incident: Air China flight CA982 at JFK was cancelled after a fuel truck drove away with hoses connected to the Boeing 747-8, spilling fuel across the tarmac.
Historian Yuan Tengfei Arrives in US: Prominent Chinese history lecturer Yuan Tengfei successfully relocated to the United States, sparking widespread online discussion and tributes.

items.title: @elonmusk: Grok 4.7 Model Launch Scheduled in 10 Days
items.body: Elon Musk announced that xAI will release Grok 4.7 in 10 days, advancing the frontier Grok model line.

items.title: @synthwavedd: Google Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash with Near-Opus Performance
items.body: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Flash, delivering performance rivaling Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on TerminalBench 2.1 and HLE while significantly cutting inference costs.

items.title: @mark_k: OpenAI Teases Next-Gen 'Astra' Model Class
items.body: AI community discussions highlighted upcoming details on OpenAI Astra, a model architecture using recurrent depth positioned above Sol-tier models.

items.title: @grok: Grok Image 2.0 Released for High-Fidelity Generation
items.body: xAI introduced Grok Image 2.0, establishing a new standard for prompt responsiveness and visual fidelity in AI image synthesis.

items.title: @AlphaSenseInc: AlphaSense Introduces SuperAnalyst Market Research Agent
items.body: AlphaSense launched SuperAnalyst, an autonomous AI research agent designed to perform multi-step market intelligence and financial analysis workflows.

items.title: @VadimStrizheus: Developers Request Subscription Stacking for AI APIs
items.body: Developers called on Anthropic and OpenAI to support subscription stacking on single accounts to simplify high-volume usage without managing multiple credentials.

items.title: @BlumeDotCodes: Blume Launches Local Agent Control Plane
items.body: Blume released an open control plane tool allowing developers to monitor, evaluate, and auto-improve autonomous AI coding agent workflows locally.

items.title: @KobeissiLetter: Uber Laying Off 10% of Workforce for $10B Robotaxi Pivot
items.body: Uber ($UBER) announced a 10% workforce reduction impacting 3,300 roles and cutting manager headcount by 20% to reallocate over $10 billion into autonomous vehicle partnerships.

items.title: @LeopoldTracker_: Leopold Aschenbrenner Q2 13F & Portfolio Breakdown
items.body: Public 13F filings confirmed former OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner's fund positions are concentrated in SanDisk ($SNDK 28.1%), Micron ($MU 27.6%), Bloom Energy ($BE 9.4%), and TSMC ($TSM 6.3%).

items.title: @drealbigvirg: Deep Dive into Robert Kiyosaki's $1.2B Debt Portfolio
items.body: Financial breakdown analyzed 'Rich Dad Poor Dad' author Robert Kiyosaki's $1.2 billion debt structure, illustrating leverage tactics in commercial real estate.

items.title: @TheEconomist: China Advances Domestic AI Semiconductor Manufacturing
items.body: Analysis by semiconductor industry experts indicates China is scaling domestic fabrication capabilities to support high-density AI cluster hardware demand.

items.title: @Apple: Apple Sets Keynote Event for September 9
items.body: Apple announced its annual fall product keynote set for September 9 at 10 a.m. PT, unveiling next-generation hardware and Apple Intelligence updates.

items.title: @davidpwalter: Tech Industry Reacts to Tim Cook Apple Retirement
items.body: Commentators and tech leaders reflected on Tim Cook's 14-year tenure as Apple CEO as John Ternus officially assumes executive leadership.

items.title: @huang3feng: Historian Yuan Tengfei Arrives in the United States
items.body: Historical scholar and public lecturer Yuan Tengfei successfully arrived in the US, ending months of speculation and marking a major personal transition.

items.title: @0xZiye: Air China Boeing 747 Fuel Truck Accident at JFK
items.body: Air China flight CA982 was cancelled at JFK airport after a fuel tanker drove away while still connected to the aircraft, causing a significant fuel spill on the apron.

items.title: @NFL: Bijan Robinson Named #3 on NFL Top 100 Players of 2026
items.body: Atlanta Falcons running back Bijan Robinson was voted #3 overall in the NFL Top 100 Players of 2026 player rankings.

items.title: @ChinaTruth: Story of Okinawa Teacher Keiko Mori's Bravery Surfaces
items.body: Viral historical account recounted the 1945 story of 22-year-old Okinawa teacher Keiko Mori, who defied military suicide orders to protect 30 young students in a cave.

items.title: @sunyuchentron: Justin Sun Invites Certified Metrology for Height Measurement
items.body: Justin Sun publicly invited accredited measurement institutions to conduct a live-streamed, millimeter-accurate measurement of his height to settle social media debate.
